jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (Contracting/Action Processing)
jobs.description:
About impact.com :

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands rely on impact.com to power millions of partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com :

We’re hiring a technical Associate Product Manager for the Action Processing (AP) and Contracting Squad — one of impact.com’s most foundational domains: how brands and partners define terms, commissions, lists, and contract workflows that power revenue on the platform.

You’ll partner closely with a Senior Product Manager and Engineering to ship customer value in a complex, data-heavy domain. This is not a “project coordinator” APM role. You’ll write crisp requirements fast, dig into how systems behave, use AI tools as part of how you work, and grow ownership quickly under structured coaching. Relative to a Product Manager role, the emphasis here is strong execution and learning velocity on a focused scope — with ownership and outcome accountability expanding as you prove out.

Time to value matters. Shape usable Markdown requirements quickly with AI. Speed with rigor is the bar.

Success looks like: clear requirements with short cycle time from ask → draft → eng-ready, strong eng partnership, reliable delivery on your slice, and rising fluency in how Contracting and Action Processing connect to other domains.

What You'll Do:

You’ll own focused feature slices with coaching from your Senior PM, with scope expanding as you prove out execution and judgment.

Feature execution & delivery

- Drive feature development for Action Processing (AP) and Contracting Squad initiatives (e.g. terms/commission behaviors, list and audience rules, contract workflows, and customer-driven requests).

- Write customer and business requirements (user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria) that engineers can build from without ambiguity.

- Partner with Engineering through build: surface risks, blockers, and acceptance gaps early.

- Write and iterate Markdown requirements that live adjacent to the GitHub repo (alongside eng context), and co-lead pre-spec and spec reviews — with short time from ambiguous ask to eng-ready draft.

Technical fluency & AI-native working

- Build working understanding of how AP and Contracting systems behave: data flows, edge cases, dependencies, and failure modes.

- Use AI tools and agents as part of your daily craft to compress cycle time — drafting specs, synthesizing research, exploring prototypes, testing edge cases, and accelerating analysis — then validate outputs yourself. The point is faster time to a good requirement, not longer polish loops.

- Get comfortable reading technical context (APIs, schemas, logs, tickets, eng design notes) enough to ask sharp questions and write better requirements.

- Protect engineering focus: clear definition of ready, early pushback on late scope changes, and avoiding rework from unclear requirements.

Squad partnership & operational excellence

- Keep a clear, healthy backlog for your scope (ticket clarity, prioritization hygiene, meeting facilitation, and request triage).

- Sequence and clarify work in partnership with your Senior PM and Engineering leads.

- Facilitate working sessions with Engineering, Design, Customer Success / Technical Services, and adjacent PMs.

- Hold regular alignment touchpoints with Product and Engineering leads to keep priorities clear.

Roadmap, go-to-market & stakeholders

- Contribute to clear communication of the squad’s planned roadmap within your scope.

- Partner with your Senior PM and Product Marketing on go-to-market activities for your launches.

- Involve the right stakeholders; escalate tradeoffs with crisp options.

- Contribute near-term input to vision and strategic initiatives in the domain.

Domain, craft & how we work

- Build deep fluency in Action Processing (AP) and Contracting domain mechanics and adjacent dependencies.

- Define and track success metrics for your work; make progress visible to your Senior PM and product leadership.

- Build stable, trusted working relationships internally; participate actively in team forums.

- Demonstrate impact.com’s Operating Principles consistently (customer focus, ownership, trust, getting the right stuff done, innovate & simplify, get better every day).

What You’ll Bring:

- Early-career product experience (internships, APM/PM rotation, technical PM adjacent roles, founder/builder experience, or equivalent impact) — or strong evidence you can operate at this level from a technical background.

- Degree in engineering or computer science (or a closely related technical field), with a strong academic record.

- Technical orientation: you are curious about how systems work, not only how tickets move. Comfortable running basic analyses from source data and using the insights to inform decisions — not only consuming reports others produce.

- Already using AI tools in real work — drafting, research synthesis, analysis, light prototyping, or workflow automation. We want someone who has started this shift, not someone who treats AI as a novelty.

- Fast time to value on requirements: you can get to a solid first draft quickly, iterate with feedback, and avoid over-shaping before eng can react.

- Bias to execution: you get the right stuff done. You prioritize ruthlessly, close loops, and ship outcomes over activity.

- Experience writing structured requirements in Markdown (or similar) — user stories, acceptance criteria, lightweight specs — including comfort working near a codebase/GitHub context (coursework, internships, side projects, or prior roles count).

- Clear written and verbal communication; ability to turn ambiguous asks into structured requirements and acceptance criteria.

- Comfort working with engineers and designers in an agile delivery environment.

- Comfort with complex / lightly documented systems and learning by immersion.

- Strong organization and follow-through: you track owners, dates, and open questions without dropping balls.

- Curiosity, coachability, and a bias to learn by doing; you ask good questions and incorporate feedback quickly.

- Customer empathy: interest in how brands and partners experience contracting, action processing, terms, and monetization workflows.

Nice To Have:

- Personal projects, prototypes, or scripts you’ve built with AI agents / coding assistants that show you ship, not just discuss.

- Exposure to marketplace, fintech, SaaS monetization, contracting, or partner/platform products.

- Experience triaging customer/support requests or working with Customer Success / field teams.

Salary Range: $85,000 – $95,000 per year, plus an additional 5% variable annual bonus contingent on Company performance and eligible to receive Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) grant. *This is the pay range the Company believes is equitable for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com , we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

- Office-only catered lunch every Thursday, a healthy snack bar, and great coffee to keep you fueled

- Flexible spending accounts and 401(k)

- Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.

- Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.

- A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.

- Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.

- Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.

- Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses.

jobs.title: GenAI Engineer - Product Marketing & Adoption
jobs.description:
Our Company:

At impact.com we are passionate about our people, our technology, and are obsessed with customer success. Working together enables us to grow rapidly, win, and serve the largest brands in the world. We use cutting edge technology to solve real-world problems for our clients and continue to pull ahead of the pack as the leading SaaS platform for businesses to automate their partnerships and grow their revenue like never before. We have an entrepreneurial spirit and a culture where ambition and curiosity is rewarded. If you are looking to join a team where your opinion is valued, your contributions are noticed, and enjoy working with fun and talented people from all over the world, then this is the place for you!

impact.com, the world’s leading partnership management platform, is transforming the way businesses manage and optimize all types of partnerships—including traditional rewards affiliates, influencers, commerce content publishers, B2B, and more. The company’s powerful, purpose-built platform makes it easy for businesses to create, manage, and scale an ecosystem of partnerships with the brands and communities that customers trust to make purchases, get information, and entertain themselves at home, at work, or on the go. To learn more about how impact.com’s technology platform and partnerships marketplace is driving revenue growth for global enterprise brands such as Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oreal, Fanatics, and Levi’s, visit www.impact.com .

Your role at Impact.com:

We are seeking a talented Gen AI engineer with a passion for creating and maintaining AI agents and generative features in our applications.  You will focus on creating, testing and maintaining prompts; monitoring answer quality; adding content to search indexes to facilitate retrieval augmented generation (RAG); and integrating with new APIs to enhance the agent’s capabilities.

Your work will enable our client users to work more efficiently and promote more relationships being created and becoming successful and better performing in our partnerships marketplace.

What You'll Do:

- Leverage Google Cloud’s Vertex AI products to maintain and enhance our “Copilot” agent feature.

- Enhance the capabilities of the agent by integrating with additional Impact or external APIs (via function calling / actions).

- Enhance the agent’s analytics capabilities with new integrations exposing additional data sets.

- Enhance the knowledge of the agent by adding more context to its search index.

- Create tools and processes for monitoring, and then monitor the agent’s answers’ quality and correctness.

- Leverage reinforcement learning (RLHF), adapter tuning or other methods to further tune the model beyond leveraging prompts, examples, and context.

- Evaluate using new LLMs with the agent as they become available.

- Work with the squad’s full stack engineer to expose new features in the user interface, and deploy the agent or point content generation capabilities throughout our apps.

- Work closely with product managers to identify new features and enhancements, estimate level of effort, prototype, implement and deploy.

- Interface with our Google solutions team to clarify gaps in documentation, report bugs or unexpected behavior, submit feature requests, or get help when evaluating a product or feature.

- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning, and continuously explore new techniques and technologies to enhance our product offerings.

What You'll Have:

- Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field .

- Technical Expertise:

- Understanding of LLM/GPT concepts

- Proficiency in prompt engineering.

- Proficiency with Python

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and/or sql query writing.

- Experience with machine learning frameworks/libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Apache MLlib, or Scikit-learn is a plus.

- Experience working in Google’s (GCP) environment is a plus.

- Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript or Java/Scala is a plus.

- Experience in and understanding of marketing/advertising industry is a plus.

- Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.

- Adaptability: Willingness to learn new skills and technologies, and to adapt to the evolving needs of the business.

- Experience : At least 1 year working in Generative AI, or extensive and demonstrable personal projects (be prepared to show in Kaggle, Github, OpenAI, etc; to demo and describe in detail, answer questions and defend critiques)

- Previous experience in a startup or fast-paced environment is a plus.

Nice to have:

- Affiliate & Partnerships Industry Fundamentals Certification by PXA

Benefits:

- Unlimited PTO policy

- Take the time off that you need. We are truly committed to a positive work-life balance, recognising that it is important to be happy and fulfilled in both

- Training & Development

- Learning the advanced partnership automation products

- Medical Aid and Provident Fund

- Group schemes with Discovery & Bonitas for medical aid

- Group scheme with Momentum for provident fund

- Stock Options

- 3-year vesting schedule pending Board approval

- Internet Allowance

- Flexible work hours

- Casual work environment

- Technology stipend

jobs.title: Product Manager, Data Products
jobs.description:
About impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products— Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

About the Role

We're seeking a Technical Product Manager to own the foundational data layer that powers our benchmarking, recommendation, classification, and personalization systems. In this role, you'll own the operational and structural integrity of our taxonomy ecosystem — spanning partner/brand/product/content classification, proprietary vertical taxonomies, and the pipeline discipline that gets new taxonomies safely into production. This is a role that demands precision, technical fluency, and comfort with ambiguity in messy real-world data — not roadmap ownership for external-facing products. You'll spend your time in classification logic, data quality audits, and the mechanics of promoting data assets from prototype (BigQuery) to production (SingleStore), working directly inside the dbt-and-pull-request workflow alongside engineering. Your work will directly influence the accuracy, consistency, and trustworthiness of the data foundation that every downstream product (search, scoring, recommendations, reporting) depends on.

Core Responsibilities

Taxonomy design & maintenance

- Own and evolve classification structures for partners, brands, products, and content.

- Design and maintain the GEO prompt category taxonomy.

- Build proprietary product taxonomies for verticals not covered by Google Merchant Center — financial services, B2B, and travel.

- Own the action tracker taxonomy and audience segmentation taxonomy.

- Collaborate with category and domain experts to refine taxonomy definitions, resolve edge cases, and adapt structures as new entity types emerge.

Data quality & hygiene

- Conduct deep-dive audits into taxonomy coverage, consistency, and correctness across systems and entity types.

- Define and track data quality KPIs (classification accuracy, coverage gaps, taxonomy drift, schema compliance) and drive remediation when they slip.

- Root-cause and resolve systematic misclassification issues at scale, not just one-off tickets.

- Build monitoring and alerting to proactively surface taxonomy or data quality degradation before it reaches downstream consumers.

Prototype-to-production pipeline (co-owned)

- Co-own the developer playbook for promoting new taxonomies, metrics, and data outputs from prototype (BigQuery) to production (SingleStore).

- Work directly inside the pull-request workflow — reviewing schema changes, validating classification logic, and coordinating promotion timing with engineering.

- Ensure new taxonomy work is production-ready: documented, tested, versioned, and maintainable by others after you've moved on to the next thing.

Insights & stakeholder communication

- Translate taxonomy and data quality findings into clear, actionable recommendations for engineering, DS, and business stakeholders.

- Build and maintain reporting on taxonomy health and coverage across verticals.

- Partner with data producers and consumers to resolve classification conflicts and taxonomy ambiguity.

Requirements:

Required

- 4+ years in a technical Product Management, data Product Management, or data governance role, with direct ownership of a taxonomy or classification system at scale.

- Working fluency in SQL and demonstrated comfort operating inside a dbt workflow — reading models, understanding lineage, reviewing pull requests. You don't need to write production dbt code daily, but you can't be intimidated by it.

- Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining a taxonomy or classification system, ideally across multiple verticals or entity types.

- Experience with BigQuery and/or SingleStore, or similar warehouse-to-serving-layer promotion patterns.

- Strong written documentation habits — taxonomy decisions need to be legible to engineering, DS, and downstream consumers, not just to you.

- Comfort with ambiguity in messy, real-world data — you find edge cases interesting, not annoying.

- Education: Bachelor's in a quantitative field (CS, Statistics, Math, Engineering, or similar); Master's/PhD preferred.

Preferred / Nice to have

- Experience with GMC (Google Merchant Center) taxonomy or similar commerce/product classification standards.

- Background in a marketplace, affiliate, or partner-ecosystem business where multi-sided classification (advertisers/publishers/products) is core.

- Familiarity with entity resolution, deduplication, or classification modeling concepts (you don't need to build the models, but you need to speak the language with the DS team that does).

- Exposure to master data management (MDM) or data governance practices.

What sets you apart

- Taxonomy obsession : You care deeply about classification correctness and understand how a sloppy taxonomy cascades into bad recommendations, bad reporting, and eroded trust downstream.

- Operational rigor over roadmap glamour : You get more satisfaction from a clean audit and a correctly resolved edge case than from a shiny new feature launch.

- Pipeline fluency : You're not afraid of dbt, PRs, or the prototype-to-production handoff — you see it as core to the job, not someone else's problem.

- Detective instincts : You love digging into messy classification data, finding systemic patterns, and tracing root causes rather than patching symptoms.

- Stakeholder fluency without scope creep : You can translate technical taxonomy work for non-technical stakeholders while staying disciplined about what is and isn't in your lane.

Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

- Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.

- Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year , with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.

- A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.

- Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.

- Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.

- Technology Financial Support: We provide a technology stipend to help you set up your home office and a monthly allowance to cover your internet expenses

jobs.description:
About impact.com
impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com :

The Product Marketing Manager II will develop and execute go-to-market strategies that bring our products to life in the market. Working cross-functionally with product, sales, and marketing teams, this role is responsible for crafting compelling positioning and messaging, enabling the sales team, and driving awareness and adoption across our target audience.

What You'll Do:

- Owns positioning and messaging for a defined product area or buying center, serving as the go-to subject matter expert across Sales, Product, and Marketing.

- Leads end-to-end product launches, managing cross-functional execution, stakeholder alignment, and timelines — with the autonomy to adjust course based on data.

- Designs and runs Voice of Customer programs (interviews, Alpha/Beta, multi-method research) and translates findings into actionable product and marketing strategy.

- Drives adoption strategy for a product area, building scalable motions and diagnosing and resolving adoption blockers across the customer journey.

- Influences the product roadmap by surfacing unmet customer needs, new use cases, and emerging market trends through ongoing research and customer engagement.

- Maintains deep competitive expertise; develops and updates competitive positioning and trains the field on how to win against key rivals.

- Ensures messaging alignment across campaigns, launches, and sales enablement materials for a consistent market narrative.

- Collaborates with Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success to capture insights during Alpha and Beta phases and close the loop on customer feedback.

- Contributes to Pricing & Packaging recommendations using market research and customer value data.

- Leads cross-functional projects with minimal supervision, managing priorities and stakeholders across a matrixed organization.

What You Bring:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

- 4–6 years of product marketing experience, with at least 2 years owning positioning and go-to-market strategy independently.
